bio.text: Jacqui Irwin, a Democrat, is a member of the California State Assembly (District 42) and the candidate for California's 26th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Irwin was born in Woodland Hills, California, lives in Thousand Oaks, and earned a bachelor of science in systems engineering from the University of California, San Diego, in 1985.

Irwin worked as an engineer at Teledyne Systems and at Johns Hopkins University's Applied Physics Lab, was elected to the Thousand Oaks City Council in 2004, and served two terms as mayor of Thousand Oaks.
